tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches Milésima's Formula 1 data since 1950 for drivers, teams, circuits, seasons and Grands Prix by name, without accents or capitals, and returns each match with a line of context and its page. Use it when you are not sure of a name. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
